fact: The Ministry of Education's Permanent Secretary directed institutions under the ministry on 13 July 2026 to fast-track integration of their digital platforms into the Education Sector Management Information System (ESMIS), so enrolment and other statistics need no manual requests.

The Teachers Service Commission's IT head says its teacher information system TSCMIS is now connected to e-Watumishi (HR), the Treasury pensioners payment system and the School Information System, to exchange teacher data.
